map.咨询师科普：用区间而非定值向顾客解释「为什么别人 20U 你 30U」。: Consultant education: use a range, not a fixed value, to explain to clients 'why others get 20 U but you get 30 U'.
map.复购记录：记录每次实际用量，长期看自己稳定区间，便于复诊沟通。: Repurchase records: log the actual dosage each time and track your stable range long-term to ease follow-up communication.
map.避坑教育：提示「按部位打包一口价」可能隐含过量或稀释风险。: Pitfall education: warn that a 'flat per-area package price' may hide over-dosing or dilution risk.
map.输入：咬肌肥大想瘦脸 → 通常选肉毒素按两侧单位计，而非玻尿酸；本工具提示别混淆: Input: Masseter hypertrophy wanting a slimmer face → usually choose botulinum toxin dosed per side, not hyaluronic acid; this tool reminds you not to confuse the materials.
map.为什么同一部位有人多有人少？: Why do some people need more and some less at the same site?
map.肌肉体积、表情强度、既往用量都不同，需医师个体化。: Muscle volume, expression intensity and prior dosage all differ; a physician must individualize.
map.单位算多会有什么后果？: What are the consequences of calculating too many units?
map.肉毒素过量可致表情僵硬、下垂；玻尿酸过量可致位移肿胀，均应及时就医。: Excess botulinum toxin can cause frozen expression and drooping; excess HA can cause displacement and swelling — seek medical care promptly in both cases.
map.本结果可作医疗依据吗？: Can this result serve as medical basis?
map.不可。仅参考区间，最终以执业医师诊断与处方为准。: No. It is only a reference range; the final word is the licensed physician's diagnosis and prescription.
